program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (3.5, 1.5, 5.0),        # diff pair L (big area for 1/f)
    "gmid3": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L3":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror load L
    "gmid6": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # PMOS CS gm/Id
    "L6":    (0.6, 0.35, 1.2),       # PMOS CS L
    "gmidn": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),      # NMOS current-source gm/Id
    "Ln":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "Itail": (8e-6, 5e-6, 11e-6),
    "I6":    (18e-6, 12e-6, 21e-6),
    "Cc":    (0.45e-12, 0.2e-12, 1.0e-12),
    "kz":    (1.2, 0.5, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]

    # NMOS bias diode and mirrored sinks
    mb0 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=mb0.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    # PMOS load and output device
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], It / 2, vds=1.1)
    m4 = m3
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["L6"], I6, vds=0.9)

    # differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.4, vsb=0.25)

    gm1, gm6 = m1.gm, m6.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + m4.cgd
    Cout = cl + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    wu = gm1 / Cc
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (C1 * Cout + Cc * (C1 + Cout))
    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 / gm6 + 1.0 / (Cc * p2))
    z = 1.0 / (Cc * max(Rz - 1.0 / gm6, 1.0))
    p3 = 1.0 / (Rz * C1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / pmir)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(wu / (2 * pmir))) - 4.0   # empirical offset vs sim
    ugbw = wu / (2 * PI)
    slew = 0.77 * min(It / Cc, I6 / (Cout + Cc))
    settle = 4.6 / (wu * 0.8) + 0.9 / slew
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I6)
    cmrr_db = db(A1 * 2 * m3.gm / mt.gds)
    psrr_db = gain_db + 3.0
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.05

    # noise: thermal + calibrated flicker (ref = previous sim, 367 nV, assumed equal split)
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300
    th2 = 2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    r1 = lut.size("n", 18.0, 2.0, 3.75e-6, vds=0.5, vsb=0.28)
    r3 = lut.size("p", 13.0, 0.6, 3.75e-6, vds=0.95)
    S0 = (3.67e-7) ** 2 - th2
    Sn = 0.5 * S0 * (r1.W * r1.L) / (m1.W * m1.L)
    Sp = 0.5 * S0 * (r3.W * r3.L) / (m3.W * m3.L) * ((m3.gm / gm1) / (r3.gm / r1.gm)) ** 2
    noise_1k = math.sqrt(th2 + Sn + Sp)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x1", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db, "swing": swing,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise_1k}
